summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Fatish Cakes luxury dessert ordering website. Covers brand design system (gold, cocoa, burnt orange), typography (Cormorant Garamond & Jost), complete page architecture (Home, Menu with filters & detail sheet, Custom Orders, Gallery, Reviews, About, Delivery Policy, FAQ, Contact), persistent cart drawer, 48-hour lead-time validation, WhatsApp order payload generator, and CMS-ready typed data architecture.
